author: PI/OpenAI
purpose: Reusable offline contrastive donor activations. These generic noun-completion prompts contain no leg counts and no current intervention input. Freeze before model extraction; use raw mean residual difference, strength1. This is a new method/control, not a reproduction of the J-lens coordinate swap.
planned_comparison: Base; donor contrast projected into the fixed spiders/dogs J-lens span; full donor contrast; full donor contrast norm-matched to the projected contrast; random contrast norm-matched to the projection. First test reverse dog-to-spider at block15, final3 prompt positions and every cached decode step,32 tokens. A changed digit alone does not establish identity; a positive result must survive a different relation and new pairs.
